unitTitle: B2 · Everyday economics: qualify numbers and recommendations
title: Dialogues
subtitle: B2 · Unit 9: B2 · Everyday economics: qualify numbers and recommendations

steps.title: Dialogues
steps.body: Listen for the speakers' goals and how each response changes the exchange. Read once for meaning, then cover the English and summarize each person's position.

steps.title: Discussing a fictional budget report
steps.body: Two learners examine a small invented data set and check what it supports.

examples.fr: La moyenne des dépenses de transport a augmenté.
examples.en: Mina: The average transportation expenses increased.

examples.fr: Est-ce que la hausse concerne tous les ménages ?
examples.en: Sam: Does the increase concern every household?

examples.fr: Le tableau ne permet pas de le savoir.
examples.en: Mina: The table does not let us know.

examples.fr: Alors, il faut éviter de généraliser le résultat.
examples.en: Sam: Then we should avoid generalizing the result.

examples.fr: Oui. On observe aussi un écart important entre les réponses.
examples.en: Mina: Yes. We also see a large gap between responses.

examples.fr: Cela pourrait s'expliquer par les distances ou les horaires.
examples.en: Sam: That could be explained by distance or schedules.

examples.fr: C'est possible, mais ces hypothèses demandent une autre enquête.
examples.en: Mina: That's possible, but those assumptions require another survey.

steps.title: Making a cautious recommendation
steps.body: A learner suggests a budget change without assuming the same option suits every household.

examples.fr: Le rapport recommande de revoir les abonnements.
examples.en: Awa: The report recommends reviewing subscriptions.

examples.fr: Cette mesure conviendrait-elle à tout le monde ?
examples.en: Marc: Would this measure suit everyone?

examples.fr: Pas nécessairement. Les besoins et les contrats varient.
examples.en: Awa: Not necessarily. Needs and contracts vary.

examples.fr: Il serait prudent de comparer les frais avant de modifier quoi que ce soit.
examples.en: Marc: It would be prudent to compare costs before changing anything.

examples.fr: D'accord, en tenant compte de la marge disponible.
examples.en: Awa: Agreed, while taking the available margin into account.
